name: Recite Practice
改动即时生效: Changes apply instantly, no save needed
标语: Read a good passage, write your own
皮肤Pro提示: Skins are Pro visuals. Activate to unlock all skins
装饰Pro提示: Lace & decorations are Pro visuals. Activate to unlock
拆分Pro提示: AI splitting is a Pro feature. Activate to use it (AI grading stays free)
移动端选块按钮: Show block-selection buttons in mobile toolbar
判卷小宠物: Grading Pet (perches on the float bar)
宠物Pro提示: This is a Pro mascot. Activate to unlock.
背景Pro提示: This background is a Pro visual. Activate to unlock all backgrounds
第三方主题背景提示: A third-party theme is in use: built-in backgrounds may not fully match its palette. This does not affect functionality.
纹理浓淡说明: Adjust paper grain intensity. 50 is the factory baseline; 0 is plain paper.
写作竖线说明: The vertical marker left of your writing during practice (write zones and your sentences). Turn off to rely on text color and the soft background only.
写位底色浓度说明: How deeply empty write slots are tinted. 100 is the factory baseline; 0 disables the tint.
题目标题级别说明: Which heading level (1-6) renders each question title in the extract & compare docs. Default H6 (compact); rebuild the doc (Rewrite / Compare) to apply.
背景图片类型不支持: Only png / jpg / webp / gif images are supported
背景图片过大: Image exceeds 8MB — please compress it first
原文浮条提示:
Set as original: clears Drill/Summary marks on source text
(backs to original); your written text is claimed as original
(copied on extract, kept on exit & wipe)
One of Original / Drill / Summary; lit button = current role
抽取无考核提示: No drill sections marked yet: select the blocks to practice and hit the floatbar Drill button
抽取完成含默写: Extracted: {} practice sections ({} with no hint - pure recall)
已恢复原文: Restored {} block(s) to original text (drill/summary marks cleared)
已认领原文: Claimed {} block(s) as original: copied on extract, kept on exit & wipe
原文入口说明: The "Set as Original" entry in the Plugins submenu when you right-click a block (clears Drill/Summary marks on source text; claims your written blocks as original, copied into the practice doc). Turning it off only hides the entry; the command and floatbar button still work, marked blocks stay effective
靶浮条提示:
Set as drill target: only this part is practiced, the rest copied as context
A summary slot follows the segment; write there to pair it
已标靶: Marked {} block(s) for drilling: summary slot added after, extract practices only this
靶非仿写提示: Enter practice mode first (click the pen icon in the toolbar), then mark a drill segment
靶入口说明: The "Drill This" entry in the Plugins submenu when you right-click a block (after marking, extraction drills only that part and copies the rest as context). Turning it off only hides the entry; the command and floatbar button still work, marked targets stay effective
花边入口说明: The "Block Frill" entry in the Plugins submenu when you right-click a block (five decorative frill styles, Pro visual). Turning it off only hides the entry; blocks that already have a frill keep rendering.
浮条Pro提示: Float bar skins are Pro visuals. Activate to unlock all styles
退出浮条提示:
Leave practice mode gently
Your writing is kept with a faint background mark; practice marks are cleared
Extract/compare docs are kept; use "Delete" to remove everything
加闪卡提示:
Add this practice doc to the quick flashcard deck
Reviewed together with excerpt cards
已加入闪卡: Added to flashcards (quick deck) — open SiYuan flashcard review to see it
取消制卡提示:
Already in the quick deck
Click again to remove

取消闪卡失败: Failed to remove the flashcard, please retry
加闪卡失败: Failed to add to flashcards, please retry
浮条收起: Hide the recite bar until you switch documents
AI判卷提示:
Grade with the AI configured in SiYuan (Settings → AI)
Overwrites the previous grading
未配置AI内容: No usable AI config found. Please set up and enable a model provider (API key) in SiYuan Settings → AI, save, then try again.
AI请求失败: AI request failed. Check network and API key, then retry
AI响应中断: AI response interrupted. Document restored, please retry
判卷完成: AI review finished and appended to the end
复制提示词提示:
Copy the grading prompt
Optionally open DeepSeek/Doubao/Qwen web UI and paste
已复制选网页: Prompt copied — click a menu item to open a web AI chat and paste
默写查错提示:
Char-level diff between source and retelling
Wrong/extra chars struck red, missing underlined green; popup only
查错·完美: Perfect match — not a single difference 🎉
查错·先写提示: No recitation in the extract doc yet — write first, then check
查错·联想说明: Association prompt · free writing, no verbatim diff
查错·纯联想: Association prompts have no verbatim diff — hit “AI Grade” for creative feedback
AI拆分提示:
AI reads the whole doc and inserts anchor notes at narrative beats
Uses your SiYuan AI config (your quota)
Re-run removes old AI anchors, handwritten notes stay
AI返回异常: AI response could not be parsed, please retry
拆分失败: Failed to insert anchor blocks, please retry
找不到锚点: Cannot find this question's anchor (may have been deleted)
本题还没写: Nothing written for this question yet
总结浮条提示:
Set as summary: treated as your own prompt, used as the exam title
Existing source text is claimed as yours (source mark cleared)
已设总结: Set {} block(s) as summary: used as exam titles on extract
已设总结认领: Set {} block(s) as summary (existing source text claimed as yours)
无选中提示: Click a target block first (cursor inside works), or drag-select / Ctrl+click multiple blocks
